episode1.source: PokéCommunity release thread (https://www.pokecommunity.com/threads/phoenix-rising.425404/, lists Episode 1 for 25 May 2018) and a GameWave article dated 4 June 2018 saying Episode 1 can be downloaded for free (https://gamewave.fr/phoenix-rising/pokemon-phoenix-rising-le-jeu-est-enfin-disponible/); read via web search on 2026-10-12. Only the year is claimed.

about: Phoenix Rising is a free, fan-made Pokémon RPG, built with RPG Maker XP and Pokémon Essentials and released in episodes. Episode 1 came out in 2018. The team shares trailers on the game’s YouTube channel and talks with players on its subreddit. It is a fan project, not made by or affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak or The Pokémon Company.
